Metadata.title: Naora · online booking with a Pix deposit
Metadata.description: Online booking for salons, barbershops and studios: clients pick a time from a link and hold it with a Pix deposit. In progress.

Home.status: In progress · free beta coming soon
Home.title: A full calendar, fewer no-shows, and less time on WhatsApp.
Home.lead: Naora will be online booking for anyone who works by appointment. Clients pick a time from a link and hold it with a Pix deposit. You see the day, the team and what came in, in one place.
Home.step1: You share your link on Instagram or WhatsApp.
Home.step2: Your client picks a service and a free time.
Home.step3: They pay a Pix deposit, and the time is held for both of you.
Home.ctaTitle: Want to try it for free?
Home.ctaText: The first version will be free for the first salons, barbershops and studios that try it and share what they think. Send me an email and I will let you know when it opens.

Footer.built: Built in public by Rayssa Roberta.
